messages:
elaine: Heads-up: drafting the customer cutover playbook for region/tenant slicing. Want to capture the non-negotiables we expect before we sign a contract. Short thread to align before I add to the roadmap doc.
omar: nice. top-level must-haves: deployment automation, SLA backstop, and a customer-facing uplift estimate. Sales gets nervous without numbers.
priya: also need a clearly defined "slice tier" taxonomy (e.g., full-isolation, soft-affinity, shared-with-affinity) and the perf/cost deltas for each.
derek: ops warning: hard isolation increases bin-packing inefficiency. we should show expected GPU utilization delta and example capacity plans.
elaine: agreed. proposal for acceptance gates (first pass):
```
- infra: automated tenant evacuation tested (dry-run <3% error surface)
- perf: p50/p95 targets met within isolated slice, documented regression limits
- telemetry: per-request routing decision logged + cost attribution
- product: sales-ready pricing matrix + playbook for discounts
- legal: data residency appendix completed
```
omar: technical routing knobs we need to expose to product:
- precedence order (region, model-variant, capacity-class)
- allowed fallbacks per-client (boolean)
- max-cost-uptick percentage for automatic fallbacks

priya: can we make a small DSL for policy templates? e.g.:
```
policy "strict-isolation" {
  prefer: region
  allow_fallbacks: false
  reserved_capacity: "high"
}
policy "affinity" {
  prefer: region
  allow_fallbacks: true
  fallback_order: ["model_variant", "capacity_class"]
  max_cost_uplift_pct: 25
}
```
derek: love the DSL. one operational rule: any policy with reserved_capacity=high must trigger finance review and a 30-day minimum commit.
finance-bot: FYI: reserve-commitments require a billing plan entry. I'll create a draft uplift table based on our current model costs and reserved prices.
priya: rollout phasing suggestion:
1) internal pilot (self-test by SRE + product)
2) invited customers (2 customers across tiers)
3) open beta (limited sign-ups, pricing flagged)
4) GA (documented SLAs and pricing)
derek: add: migration safety net - automated fallback to "best-effort" routing for up to 10m during cutover, and an evacuation playbook runbook.
elaine: we also need evaluation criteria for model-quality under fallback. propose a simple regression test: sample prompt set + accept thresholds (BLEU/ROUGE or custom scoring).
omar: telemetry table to collect during pilots: token_cost, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate, chosen_model, fallback_reason, request_size_tokens. These feed Optimize.
priya: product asks for a customer-facing one-pager that explains: what isolation buys them, cost tradeoffs, rollback guarantees, and expected timeline. I'll draft and loop in marketing.
derek: ops will mock a cutover and post logs in the runbook channel. target date for dry-run: next Tue.
elaine: action items: 1) priya draft policy taxonomy + DSL examples (Thu), 2) derek run evacuation dry-run (Tue), 3) finance-bot to post uplift table (Fri), 4) omar to add routing telemetry schema to telemetry repo (Wed).
deploy-bot: meeting scheduled: "Slice Cutover Playbook & Pricing" Mon 11:00  https://meet.redwood/teams/slice-cutover (added elaine, omar, priya, derek) :calendar:
